meta.description: Converts peptide/PSM/reporter signal into a normalized protein abundance matrix across label-free (median centering, MaxLFQ via iq), isobaric (TMT/iTRAQ reporter extraction, impurity correction, sample-loading + IRS plex bridging), SILAC (labeling efficiency, Arg->Pro, on/off-preserving ratios) and AP-MS (enrichment over negative-control IPs) workflows, with MSstats Tukey median polish for summarization. Statistical testing is routed to differential-abundance.
meta.audit_note: Re-audit after pass 3 (1b80f7d: iq maxLFQ table route, named $estimate, TMTpro impurity limits) and pass 4 (1855824: SILAC labeling efficiency / Arg->Pro, AP-MS control scoring). Previous score 84, Limited Release, one point below the CORE floor. All 9 inputs of the previous audit were re-run as regression tests and 2 new inputs were added that probe the new code beyond the fixer's own test case. Every number below came from a run made by this auditor on 2026-09-15; the fix log was read but is not evidence.
meta.environment: R 4.4.3 via the candidate's r.sh (MSstats 4.14.2, MSnbase 2.32.0, iq 2.0.1, limma 3.62.2, arrow 23.0.1.2); Python 3.12 shared venv (pandas 3.0.5, numpy 2.5.3). Nothing was installed and no shared version was changed.
meta.data: ALL SYNTHETIC. The first audit's seeded fixtures in audits/bio-proteomics-quantification/data/ (MaxQuant evidence.txt 10,369 rows + proteinGroups.txt, TMT10 mzML with a reporter truth table, two TMT plexes, a SILAC protein table with truth, an 800-protein AP-MS matrix with 1 bait / 15 interactors / 60 sticky binders), the shared synthetic DIA-NN report.parquet, plus two generators written for this audit (a heavy-only SILAC pilot and an Arg->Pro ratio table) in rerun4/in10_silac_pilot.py.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated results or citations. Every quantitative claim the Skill makes that this audit could test held: the TMTpro template limit (x = 4/6/8/10 succeed, 11 and 16 stop with the exact quoted error), the existence of TMT16 and the absence of TMT18 in MSnbase 2.32.0, the unnamed iq $estimate vector, the log2(e/(2-e)) 1:1 SILAC bias formula (confirmed by independent simulation to 4 decimal places at three incorporation levels), and the claim that ranking a pulldown against the input lysate returns background (46 of the top 50 are sticky binders on the fixture).

practice_boundaries.detail: The Scope paragraph carries an explicit clinical stop: 'Research quantification must not be used to classify individual patients or choose treatment; route those questions to validated clinical assays.' Input 6 (iBAQ -> proteomic ruler -> who gets trastuzumab) is declined on those grounds.

methodological_ground.detail: No principled fallacy. The Skill correctly separates normalization from summarization, requires run-normalized input before iq::maxLFQ (confirmed load-bearing: per-run medians spread +/-0.44 without it against +/-0.14 with it), refuses data-internal normalization for AP-MS, states the composition caveat on median centering, and treats TMT ratio compression as physical rather than correctable.

code_usability.detail: All eight fenced blocks were extracted verbatim and executed: three R blocks under Rscript (MSstats, iq maxLFQ, MSnbase TMT) and five Python blocks, plus examples/lfq_normalization.py. No syntax error, no missing dependency, no hang; the TMT block returns in 20.9 s.

functional_suitability.note: Completeness 3: every quant family now has running code (MSstats summarization, table-level iq MaxLFQ, TMT reporter extraction + impurity correction, SL+IRS bridging, SILAC labeling efficiency + Arg->Pro + ratios, AP-MS control scoring) - the four gaps the previous audit raised as a P1 are all closed - but TMTpro 16plex is still prose plus a block comment, with the runnable block hardcoded to TMT10/x = 10. Correctness 4: every claim checked matched runtime. Appropriateness 4.

reliability.note: Fault tolerance 4: row-count stopifnot on both MaxQuant reads, IRS masking of zero/NaN references, SILAC presence flags instead of +/-Inf, a ValueError on an all-zero pilot, and NaN rather than Inf for AP-MS prey with no bait signal. Error reporting 3: IRS names the unbridged proteins, but an AP-MS control IP that failed entirely is silently absorbed by the column-wise mean with no diagnostic. Recoverability 3: stateless blocks, rerunnable.

performance_context.note: Token cost 3: 404 lines (was 308) in one file with no references/ split. Execution efficiency 4: the heaviest block (MSnbase reporter extraction from an mzML) returns in 20.9 s; iq maxLFQ over 299 proteins x 8 runs is seconds.

agent_usability.note: Learnability 4: the MaxLFQ block is now the documented preprocess -> create_protein_list -> create_protein_table route rather than a single-protein call under a table-level Goal. Consistency 4: the MBimpute/AFT wording still agrees with differential-abundance. Feedback design 3: several blocks print diagnostics but there is no stated expected output per block. Error prevention 4: the unnamed-$estimate trap, the run-normalization requirement, the TMT template limit, the 'no data-internal normalization in AP-MS' rule and the input-lysate warning are all preventive and all verified real.

human_usability.note: Discoverability 3: real vocabulary and natural prompts, but the description is long. Forgiveness 4 (Category 3 override applied): strict input rejection is correct here, and the messages identify the specific failure - 'no peptide has signal in either channel -- wrong columns or wrong file' names both causes.

security.note: Credential safety 4, input validation 3, data safety 4. No eval/exec of user input, no shell, no network, no credentials. edit = FALSE on makeImpuritiesMatrix removes the only interactive call.

maintainability.note: Modularity 3: one section per quant family, all inline. Modifiability 4: the new code is plain functions with explicit column-name parameters, so retargeting to another export is a keyword argument. Testability 3: the shipped example covers median centering and IRS only - nothing exercises the SILAC or AP-MS functions, and examples/lfq_normalization.py is not referenced from SKILL.md or usage-guide.md at all.

agent_specific.note: Trigger precision 4, composability 4 (clean hand-offs to differential-abundance, dia-analysis, data-import, protein-inference), idempotency 4 (no stochastic step anywhere), escape hatches 4 (the clinical stop sentence, min_bait_reps, the CoA filename= route for TMTpro, the SAINTexpress/CompPASS/CRAPome routing). Progressive disclosure 3: 404 lines in one file.

inputs.label: NEW: does the SILAC labeling-efficiency code MODEL correctly, across a range, or only parse?
inputs.note: An independent pilot generator (different seed, per-peptide logit jitter, log-normal intensities over four orders of magnitude) was swept over seven incorporation levels from 0.999 to 0.50 and six Arg->Pro conversion rates from 0 to 0.30. silac_labeling_efficiency recovered the intensity-weighted truth to 4 decimal places at every level. The log2(e/(2-e)) bias formula was checked NOT by algebra but by simulating an actual 1:1 forward mix of 40,000 peptides: simulated median log2 H/L -0.0577 / -0.2023 / -0.3479 at e = 0.98 / 0.93 / 0.88 against the Skill's -0.0577 / -0.2023 / -0.3479, agreeing to every printed digit. arg_to_pro_shift recovered conversion within +/-0.004 across the whole range, and - the discriminating test - a FLAT -0.30 log2 offset with no proline dose gave slope -0.0036 and implied conversion 0.0025, so incomplete labeling does not masquerade as Arg->Pro. The all-zero guard raises; a single peptide with no proline variation returns NaN rather than crashing.
inputs.execution_note: Both functions extracted verbatim from SKILL.md; generators written for this audit in rerun4/in10_silac_pilot.py and documented as synthetic.

assertions.text: The incorporation estimate tracks the truth across the useful range
The 1:1 ratio-bias formula is correct, not merely plausible
assertions.note: Confirmed against an independent forward-mix simulation at three incorporation levels; this is the claim that turns a pilot number into an interpretation of every downstream ratio.

assertions.text: The Arg->Pro slope recovers the true conversion rate
Arg->Pro is distinguished from a flat labeling offset, as the docstring claims
assertions.note: A -0.30 offset with no proline dose gives slope -0.0036 and implied conversion 0.0025.

assertions.text: The guards fire on degenerate input rather than returning a number
assertions.note: All-zero table raises ValueError with a message naming both causes; a no-variation table returns NaN for the slope.

inputs.label: NEW: edges of the AP-MS scorer - dropouts, failed controls, one control replicate, spectral counts
inputs.note: Six probes. (a) A true interactor missing in ONE of three bait replicates is dropped by the default min_bait_reps = len(bait_cols) despite an enrichment of 5.42; passing min_bait_reps = 2 recovers it, so the escape hatch works, but nothing in the prose discusses the tradeoff and a stochastic dropout in 1 of 3 replicates is routine. (b) Prey seen only in the bait scores a finite 4.75 and is called - the detection floor behaves as documented. (c) Prey seen only in the controls gets NaN and is never called. (d) An ENTIRELY failed control IP is absorbed silently: the column-wise mean skips it, the call set is unchanged at 17 with 15/15 interactors, and nothing warns that one third of the control evidence vanished. (e) With a single control replicate the call set grows to 24 and 8 background proteins leak in. (f) Spectral counts instead of intensities give an identical result, as the docstring says.
inputs.execution_note: Python block extracted verbatim; each probe is a modified copy of the fixture, never the fixture itself.

assertions.note: Control-only prey get NaN; 0 Inf cells across every probe.

assertions.note: Identical 17 calls and 15/15 interactors on a count-scaled matrix.

assertions.text: A reproducibility requirement that a user can loosen is exposed
assertions.note: min_bait_reps = 2 recovers an interactor the strict default drops.

assertions.text: A control IP that produced no data is flagged rather than silently absorbed
assertions.note: Zeroing one whole control run changes nothing in the output and prints no warning; the mean simply skips it, so a failed control is indistinguishable from a good one.

key_strengths: The P1 that held this Skill at 84 is fully closed, and the new code models correctly rather than merely parsing: the SILAC estimator recovers incorporation and Arg->Pro conversion across a swept range, and its 1:1 ratio-bias formula survives an independent forward-mix simulation to four decimal places.

The AP-MS scorer earns its section. On an 800-protein fixture it calls 15 of 15 true interactors and 0 of 60 sticky bead binders, while the route the Skill explicitly warns against - median-normalize and rank against the input lysate - returns 46 sticky binders in its top 50.

The MaxLFQ block now does what its own Goal says. The same text produces a 299 x 8 matrix from a MaxQuant evidence table and a 947 x 8 matrix from a DIA-NN report, and the two traps it warns about are both real on iq 2.0.1: the unnamed $estimate vector, and the unsorted column order that would silently transpose samples without setNames.

Its factual claims about the installed stack are checkable and check out - the TMTpro template limit, the exact MSnbase error text, the presence of TMT16 and absence of TMT18, and the requirement that iq input be run-normalized (per-run median spread 0.20 log2 with it, 0.74 without).

recommendations.title: TMTpro still needs hand-editing from a comment
recommendations.problem: The runnable block is hardcoded to reporters = TMT10 and x = 10, so a TMTpro user has to reconstruct the call from a comment. The comment's CoA layout description also omits the leading channel-tag column that makeImpuritiesMatrix reads as row.names, and a CSV built exactly as described fails with "duplicate 'row.names' are not allowed".
recommendations.root_cause: Pass 3 closed the gap in prose because adding a second reporter block was treated as new content.
recommendations.fix: Add three commented lines beside the TMT10 call (`quant <- quantify(raw, reporters = TMT16, method = 'max')` / `imp <- makeImpuritiesMatrix(filename = 'lot_coa.csv', edit = FALSE)`), and change the layout sentence to 'a leading Tag column of channel names, then n neighbour-offset columns' with the two-line header of MSnbase's TMT6plexPurityCorrections.csv shown inline.

recommendations.title: AP-MS scorer absorbs a failed control IP silently
recommendations.problem: Zeroing an entire control replicate leaves the call set identical at 17 and prints nothing. The column-wise mean skips the all-NaN column, so a control IP that produced no data is indistinguishable from one that worked.
recommendations.root_cause: `Lf[ctrl_cols].mean(axis=1)` and the `L[ctrl_cols].min()` floor are both skipna, which is right per-prey but hides a per-RUN failure.
recommendations.fix: Add two lines after the log transform: `dead = [c for c in ctrl_cols if L[c].notna().sum() == 0]` and `if dead: print(f'AP-MS: control runs with no data, excluded: {dead}')`, and report `n_ctrl_runs_used` in the output frame.

recommendations.title: min_bait_reps default tradeoff is undiscussed
recommendations.problem: A true interactor with an enrichment of 5.42 that is missing in one of three bait replicates is dropped by the default. That is a defensible choice, and the parameter exists, but the Approach text says only 'reproducibility first' and never says what a stochastic dropout in 1 of 3 costs.
recommendations.root_cause: The default was chosen for the fixture, where every true interactor is present in all three.
recommendations.fix: Add one sentence: at 3 bait replicates, requiring all three trades sensitivity for specificity; `min_bait_reps=2` is the usual compromise, and report how many prey each setting adds so the choice is visible.

recommendations.title: Nothing exercises the SILAC or AP-MS code
recommendations.problem: examples/lfq_normalization.py covers median centering and IRS only, and is not referenced from SKILL.md or usage-guide.md at all. The four functions added in passes 3 and 4 have no worked example with a stated expected output.
recommendations.root_cause: The example predates the new sections and no pass revisited it.
recommendations.fix: Extend the example with a seeded SILAC pilot (assert incorporation ~0.93) and a small AP-MS matrix (assert the sticky binders are excluded), and cite `examples/lfq_normalization.py` from the normalization and IRS sections.

recommendations.title: 404 lines in one file with no progressive disclosure
recommendations.problem: An agent asked only to median-centre an LFQ matrix loads the TMT, SILAC and AP-MS sections as well.
recommendations.root_cause: Passes 3 and 4 added roughly 100 lines of new sections without splitting the file.
recommendations.fix: Move the SILAC and AP-MS sections into `references/labeled_quant.md` and `references/affinity_enrichment.md`, leaving the LFQ/TMT core, the failure modes and the Common Errors table in SKILL.md.
